assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of intermittent palpitations.
The patient has subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats.
The presentation prompted further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia.
The goal is to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances.
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered.
The study is intended to capture electrocardiographic data during symptom onset.
The service addresses the clinical need to evaluate suspected cardiac arrhythmia.
The associated diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R00.2.
